about: Every frame of the board as its own PNG at native size (1280 x 720), in frames/: <option>_<subject>_<zoom>.png (zoom 035 is the planning zoom 0.35), the palette row's pal_<hue>_*.png, and the generator's overview_<seed>.png (one frame a seed, the whole 5 km map). board.png is the sheet of 1:1 crops of these.
